name: Ōizumi (Gunma, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōizumi town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Ōizumi, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1961.

features.role: Ōizumi town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top
